dom_changes: removed the remotecontrol attribute from each browser window's root element (automation cue)
edits: cursor and click ripples drawn on the frames afterwards (a headless window has no pointer; hover states are not shown)
typing shown at a fixed pace of one frame per key, each key really typed into the field
while the window the video cuts to is not up yet (a new instance starting, or one already running opening the link), nothing is recorded: the video cuts to that window once it is up
the last frame is held for 0.6 s at the end

encoders.loop: Pillow WebP q60, 10 fps, at most 5 s, played once

profile-opens-pt-BR.transcript: Na tela: Configurações › Perfis, com «Pessoal» e «Trabalho»; clique em Abrir no «Trabalho»; a janela do «Trabalho» abre, com a faixa «Trabalho · Sem senha».

captions.text: Em Configurações › Perfis, cada parte da vida tem o seu perfil.
«Trabalho» abre numa janela só dele, com cor e nome próprios.
Histórico, logins e cookies do «Trabalho» ficam separados dos do «Pessoal».

notes: Settings was scrolled by the script before the first frame, so that the list of profiles ends at the bottom (the search choice of a new profile, below it, lists providers)
the work profile was created by the script (NulavioProfiles.create, template work) before the scene
the tabs each window opened with were replaced by the script with fixture pages on loopback before that window's first frame (a window's own first page, the new tab, names a search engine)

profile-opens-en-US.transcript: On screen: Settings › Profiles, with “Personal” and “Work”; a click on Open for “Work”; the “Work” window opens, its band reading “Work · No password”.

captions.text: In Settings › Profiles, each part of life has a profile of its own.
“Work” opens in its own window, with its own colour and name.
“Work” keeps its history, logins and cookies apart from “Personal”.

notes: Settings was scrolled by the script before the first frame, so that the list of profiles ends at the bottom (the search choice of a new profile, below it, lists providers)
the work profile was created by the script (NulavioProfiles.create, template work) before the scene
the tabs each window opened with were replaced by the script with fixture pages on loopback before that window's first frame (a window's own first page, the new tab, names a search engine)

link-routed-pt-BR.transcript: Na tela: no perfil «Pessoal», o endereço «http://localhost:36491/intranet» é digitado; ele abre na janela do «Trabalho», cuja faixa diz «Aberto pela sua regra · Mudar».

captions.text: Uma regra manda a intranet do trabalho para o «Trabalho».
No perfil «Pessoal», digita-se o endereço dela.
O link abre na janela do «Trabalho», e a faixa diz que foi a sua regra.

notes: the work profile was created by the script (NulavioProfiles.create, template work) before the scene
the routing rule (localhost opens in the work profile) was added by the script before the scene
the personal profile's search engine was set by the script to a local test engine on loopback
the work profile was started by the script before the scene
the tabs each window opened with were replaced by the script with fixture pages on loopback before that window's first frame (a window's own first page, the new tab, names a search engine)

link-routed-en-US.transcript: On screen: in the “Personal” profile, the address “http://localhost:45065/intranet” is typed; it opens in the “Work” window, whose band says “Opened by your rule · Change”.

captions.text: A rule sends the work intranet to the “Work” profile.
In the “Personal” profile, its address is typed.
The link opens in the “Work” window, and the band says the rule did it.

notes: the work profile was created by the script (NulavioProfiles.create, template work) before the scene

protected-unlocks-pt-BR.transcript: Na tela: Configurações › Perfis, com «Bancos» bloqueado; clique em Desbloquear; a página de desbloqueio pede a senha, que é digitada; ela diz «Bancos está desbloqueado e abrindo. Ele volta a bloquear quando você fechar a última janela dele.»; a janela do «Bancos» abre, com a faixa «Bancos · Protegido».

captions.text: O perfil «Bancos» é protegido: os arquivos dele ficam cifrados enquanto está bloqueado.
Para abri-lo, a senha do perfil.
Desbloqueado, ele abre na sua própria janela.

notes: Settings was scrolled by the script before the first frame, so that the list of profiles ends at the bottom (the search choice of a new profile, below it, lists providers)
the protected profile was created by the script (NulavioVault.createProtected, an artificial password), then unlocked and locked again once to write its recording prefs inside its volume
the tabs each window opened with were replaced by the script with fixture pages on loopback before that window's first frame (a window's own first page, the new tab, names a search engine)

protected-unlocks-en-US.transcript: On screen: Settings › Profiles, with “Banking” locked; a click on Unlock; the unlock page asks for the password, which is typed; it says “Banking is unlocked and opening. It locks again when you close its last window.”; the “Banking” window opens, its band reading “Banking · Protected”.

captions.text: The “Banking” profile is protected: its files stay encrypted while it is locked.
To open it, the profile's password.
Once unlocked, it opens in a window of its own.
